old_problem: The Procedure is only the vendor test label, so it cannot authorize a guessed command, BDF or control primitive. The Criteria nevertheless defines the required Gen2-to-Gen5 transition pair and 500-cycle coverage.
disposition_reason: Review semantics are sufficient: execute the owner-pinned Speed Change 25 primitive only if it is certified to implement the Criteria-defined Gen2-to-Gen5 transition. Treating its exact package/configuration, mapped path, start enforcement and Gen5 acceptance as runtime Project Configuration resolves the review without inventing an OEM command or weakening coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2108, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2109 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00030-V002 / f8e4eb6552db3537 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The Criteria is authoritative for 500 Gen2-to-Gen5 LTSSM changes; the Speed Change 25 label must be resolved to a pinned vendor primitive that demonstrably implements exactly that pair.
Do not infer the command from the numeric label, an adjacent row or a generic speed-change action; bind the signed package, configuration and target path at runtime.

Require end-to-end Gen5 capability and per-cycle proof of full-width Gen2 entry before recording Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and fresh error deltas.
Count only complete chronological transactions; a final Gen5 snapshot or lower-generation result cannot satisfy the case.

Stop before another request on semantic mismatch, invalid start, unsupported Gen5, equalization/retrain failure, width loss, endpoint/sibling loss, new disqualifying error/reset, log gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence; do not clear or automatically retry; use only the approved out-of-band recovery.
No vendor command, LTSSM/NVQual action, speed change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Owner-bound Speed Change 25: 500 verified Gen2-to-Gen5 transactions
test_case.purpose: Prove the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path completes five hundred genuine full-width Gen2-to-Gen5 transitions using the authoritative Speed Change 25 primitive, within approved equalization/settle and error limits.
required_package: Owner-signed NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 25 build, command and configuration implementing Gen2-to-Gen5
Immutable Gen5-capable root-port/switch/retimer/backplane/endpoint/GPU/lane path and expected width
Gen5 equalization/LTSSM/settle/transient/error and exact 500-count acceptance rules
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration binds an authoritative Speed Change 25 primitive certified for the Criteria-defined Gen2-to-Gen5 pair. Preserve baselines; after point approval execute only that pinned primitive for entries 1..500. Prove Gen2/full width before each request, then capture request, Gen5 equalization/LTSSM, settled width/speed, enumeration, errors and health before enabling the next entry. Stop on first mismatch, fault or evidence gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The pinned primitive is traceably Gen2-to-Gen5, and all 500 entries independently prove full-width Gen2 start and Gen5 settle within the approved envelope, with required devices present and no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Speed Change 25 semantics, package, topology, Gen5 capability and limits are approved. Then PASS requires 500 complete accepted Gen2-to-Gen5 records. FAIL on primitive/scope mismatch, invalid start, unsupported/late/wrong/reduced target, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; replay cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the vendor primitive is mapped to Gen2-to-Gen5 and tool/path/capability/start/acceptance/recovery are signed.
Use an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Preserve every starting, equalization/transition and final state with raw error evidence.
Stop without retry on first semantic, capability, state, link/device, error/evidence or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed Speed Change 25-to-Gen2/Gen5 mapping
Pinned tool/configuration and complete Gen5-capable path/lane map
Gen2-start plus Gen5 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and pre-test health baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen5/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On semantic mismatch, invalid Gen2 entry, unsupported or failed/late/downtrained Gen5, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not substitute another speed-change primitive or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: The vendor label is underspecified but Criteria clearly defines the Gen2-to-Gen5 pair and count; no source field supplies a competing scope.

blocked.reason: The parameterized review method is complete; runtime execution is conditionally blocked until the owner maps the named primitive and supplies the project configuration.
